name: DroneSentry-C2 (DroneShield)
description: Commercial C-UAS C2 built on the SensorFusionAI 3D fusion engine. Fuses RF, radar, optical and ADS-B inputs from DroneShield and third-party sensors, drives DroneShield and partner effectors, and speaks SAPIENT and Cursor-on-Target.

decisionLatencyS.note: Planning factor: DEFAULT_FIRE_DOCTRINE.declareHostileS is 10 s (src/model/types.ts), the operator dwell after identification before release. Trade reporting brackets it: 2 to 5 s from operator acceptance to release under pre-authorised ROE, 10 to 30 s more where a commander releases (Corvus Intelligence, 'Counter-UAS C2 software', read 2026-09-10). No vendor publishes a decision latency.

decisionLatencySigmaDb.note: Planning factor: 3 dB is a factor of 2 at 1 sigma on the 10 log10 convention, which spans the 5 to 20 s band the reporting gives around a 10 s median.

operatorTrackCapacity.note: Planning factor: 'the human operator can only update a maximum of six tracks about once per two seconds and that only for a short time' (Fundamentals of Naval Weapons Systems, ch. 6 Track-While-Scan Concepts, FAS mirror). Automation raises the number a console can display, not the number one operator decides on; no vendor publishes an operator capacity.
